<script>
	var i = 0;
	var txt_input_1 = "Քաղաք, փողոց, շենքի համար";
	var txt_input_2 = "Քաղաք, փողոց, շենքի համար";
	var txt_input_3 = "Մուտքագրեք ուղղված հասցեն";
	var speed = 50;
	
	$(document).ready(function(){
		introJs().onchange(function(targetElement) {
			$('.new_header_top_block_lang').addClass('intro_js_lang');
			if(targetElement.id=="new_header_address_search"){
				$(function(){
					$("#new_header_address_search").typed({
						strings: [txt_input_1],
					});
					$("#new_header_address_search").on('click',function(){
						introJs().exit();
					});
				});
			}
			if(targetElement.id=="new_header_address_search_under_map"){
			$('#open_new_popup_map').trigger('click');
				$(function(){
					$("#new_header_address_search_under_map").typed({
						strings: [txt_input_2],
						callback:function(){
							$('#map_address_street_correct_button').show();
							$('#map_address_street_correct_button').trigger('click');
						}
					});
				});
			}
			
			if(targetElement.id=="map_address_street_correct_input"){
				$('#map_address_street_correct_button').show();
			}
			if(targetElement.id=="map_address_street_correct_input_textarea"){
				$(function(){
					$("#map_address_street_correct_input_textarea").typed({
						strings: [txt_input_3],
					});
				});
				setTimeout(function(){
					introJs().exit();
				}, 5000);
				
			}
			
			
		}).start();  
		introJs.fn.oncomplete(function(){
			$('.new_header_top_block_lang').removeClass('intro_js_lang');
			$.fancybox.close();
			$("#new_header_address_search").val('');
			$("#new_header_address_search_under_map").val('');
			$("#map_address_street_correct_input_textarea").html('');
			setCookie('intro_is_opened',1);
		});
		introJs.fn.onexit(function(){
			$('.new_header_top_block_lang').removeClass('intro_js_lang');
			$.fancybox.close();
			$("#new_header_address_search").val('');
			$("#new_header_address_search_under_map").val('');
			$("#map_address_street_correct_input_textarea").html('');
			setCookie('intro_is_opened',1);
		});
	})
	
	
	</script>

.new_rest_left_block{
	margin: 40px 20px 0px 0px;
	width: 245px;
	float:left;
}
.restaurants_block .filter_block{
	padding: 40px 0px 0px 0px;
}

	background:#f2f2f2;
	margin:0 0 20px 0;
	padding: 30px 20px 20px 20px;
}
.left-column .newtitle{
	margin:0 0 0 0;
	font-family:Montserrat-Regular;
	font-size:12px;
	color:#ac0000;
	margin-bottom:20px;
}
.left-column-inner{
	margin:0;
	padding:0;
}
.left-column input[type="checkbox"] + label a{
	color:#000000;
	font-family:Montserrat-Regular;
	font-size:11px;
}
.left-column input[type="checkbox"] + label a.active{
	color:#ac0000;
	font-family:Montserrat-Regular;
	font-size:11px;
}
.filter_block .map-my-location,.filter_block .map-icon,.filter_block .grid{
	margin:0 10px 0 0;
}

.rest_open_filter-status-block a{
	text-decoration:none;
	padding:10px 50px;
	color:#828282;
	font-family:Montserrat-Regular;
	font-size:12px;
	display:block;
	float:left;
}
.rest_open_filter-status-block a.first{
	border-left:1px solid #d9d9d9;
	border-top:1px solid #d9d9d9;
	border-bottom:1px solid #d9d9d9;
	border-top-left-radius:3px;
	border-bottom-left-radius:3px;
	position:relative;
}
.rest_open_filter-status-block a.first:after{
	content:"";
	position:absolute;
	border-left:1px solid #b80010;
	right:0;
	top:0;
	height:100%;
}
.rest_open_filter-status-block a.last{
	border-right:1px solid #d9d9d9;
	border-top:1px solid #d9d9d9;
	border-bottom:1px solid #d9d9d9;
	border-top-right-radius:3px;
	border-bottom-right-radius:3px;
}
.rest_open_filter-status-block a.active{
	border-color:#b80010;
	color:#b80010;
}
.new_search_block{
	position:relative;
	margin-bottom: 21px;
}
.left_block_seach_form_input_and_button{
	position:relative;
}
.left_block_seach_form_input_submit{
	position:absolute;
	right:0;
	top:0;
	background:url('https://static.menu.am/resources/default/css/images/svg/search.svg') no-repeat center;
	z-index:1;
	height: 100%;
    border: none;
	outline:none;
}
.left_block_seach_form_input{
	margin: 0;
    padding: 0;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d9d9;

    background: none;
    outline: none;
    padding: 9px 0;

    float: none;

    font-family: Montserrat-Regular;
}

	height:35px;

	margin-right:10px;
	border:1px solid #dcdcdc;

}
.block3_items.new_grid{
	background:url('https://static.menu.am/resources/default/css/images/svg/grid.svg') no-repeat center;
}
.block3_items.new_map-icon{

}
.block3_items.new_map-my-location{
	background:url('https://static.menu.am/resources/default/css/images/svg/geolocation.svg') no-repeat center;
}
.block3_items.new_map-my-location:hover{

}
a.block3_items.active{

}
.new_add_to_favorite_rest_btn{

}

<script type="text/javascript">
    $('.show_more_rests_button').on('click', function (){

        var page = $(this).data("page");
        var limit = $(this).data("limit");
        var maxlimit = $(this).data("maxlimit");

		if(maxlimit < page*limit){
            $('.show_more_rests_button').css({'display': 'none'})
        }


        var u_lat = $(this).data("userlat");
        var u_long = $(this).data("userlong");
		var divs = $('.restaurants_grid').find('.item');

        for(var i = (page-1)*limit; i < (page)*limit; i++ )
		{
            $(divs[i]).css({'display': 'block'});
		}
		$(this).data('page', page+1);
		return false;
    });

    $(function(){
        $(".list-logo img.lazy").lazyload({
            effect : "fadeIn",
            placeholder: "#fff"
        });
        $(".list-logo img.lazy").css("visibility","visible");
    })

</script>

<script>

		apiKey: "AIzaSyBCZuoVpChfW9OI_ONu3VO9caEWwqGWxTI",
		authDomain: "menuam-bdc61.firebaseapp.com",

  // [START get_messaging_object]
  // Retrieve Firebase Messaging object.
  const messaging = firebase.messaging();
  
  // [END get_messaging_object]

  // IDs of divs that display Instance ID token UI or request permission UI.
  const tokenDivId = 'token_div';
  const permissionDivId = 'permission_div';

  // [START refresh_token]
  // Callback fired if Instance ID token is updated.
  messaging.onTokenRefresh(function() {
    messaging.getToken()
    .then(function(refreshedToken) {
      //console.log('Token refreshed.');
      // Indicate that the new Instance ID token has not yet been sent to the
      // app server.
      setTokenSentToServer(false);
      // Send Instance ID token to app server.
      sendTokenToServer(refreshedToken);
      // [START_EXCLUDE]
      // Display new Instance ID token and clear UI of all previous messages.
      resetUI();
      // [END_EXCLUDE]
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
      //console.log('Unable to retrieve refreshed token ', err);
      showToken('Unable to retrieve refreshed token ', err);
    });
  });
  // [END refresh_token]

  // [START receive_message]
  // Handle incoming messages. Called when:
  // - a message is received while the app has focus
  // - the user clicks on an app notification created by a sevice worker
  //   `messaging.setBackgroundMessageHandler` handler.
  messaging.onMessage(function(payload) {
    //console.log("Message received. ", payload);
    // [START_EXCLUDE]
    // Update the UI to include the received message.
    appendMessage(payload);
    // [END_EXCLUDE]
  });
  // [END receive_message]

  function resetUI() {
    clearMessages();
    showToken('loading...');
    // [START get_token]
    // Get Instance ID token. Initially this makes a network call, once retrieved
    // subsequent calls to getToken will return from cache.
    messaging.getToken()
    .then(function(currentToken) {
      if (currentToken) {
        sendTokenToServer(currentToken);
        updateUIForPushEnabled(currentToken);
      } else {
        // Show permission request.
        //console.log('No Instance ID token available. Request permission to generate one.');
        // Show permission UI.
        updateUIForPushPermissionRequired();
        setTokenSentToServer(false);
      }
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
      //console.log('An error occurred while retrieving token. ', err);
      showToken('Error retrieving Instance ID token. ', err);
      setTokenSentToServer(false);
    });
  }
  // [END get_token]

  function showToken(currentToken) {
    // Show token in console and UI.
    var tokenElement = document.querySelector('#token');
    tokenElement.textContent = currentToken;
  }

  // Send the Instance ID token your application server, so that it can:
  // - send messages back to this app
  // - subscribe/unsubscribe the token from topics
  function sendTokenToServer(currentToken) {
    if (!isTokenSentToServer()) {
		//console.log('Sending token to server...');
		// TODO(developer): Send the current token to your server.
		setTokenSentToServer(true);
		//console.log(currentToken);
		$.ajax({
			url:"/home/registerUserForNitification",
			type:'post',
			data:{token:currentToken},
			success: function (data) {
				secondNotificationPopupShow();

			},
			error: function () {
				//	alert('unable to get Restaurant') ;
			}
		}) ;

		return false;
	  
    } else {
      //console.log("Token already sent to server so won't send it again " + "unless it changes");
    }

  }

  
  function isTokenSentToServer() {
    if (window.localStorage.getItem('sentToServer') == 1) {
          return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function setTokenSentToServer(sent) {
    window.localStorage.setItem('sentToServer', sent ? 1 : 0);
  }

  function showHideDiv(divId, show) {
    const div = document.querySelector('#' + divId);
    if (show) {
      div.style = "display: visible";
    } else {
      div.style = "display: none";
    }
  }


  function requestPermission() {
	
    //console.log('Requesting permission...');
    // [START request_permission]
    messaging.requestPermission()
    .then(function() {
		notificationpopupclose();
		
      //console.log('Notification permission granted.');
      // TODO(developer): Retrieve an Instance ID token for use with FCM.
      // [START_EXCLUDE]
      // In many cases once an app has been granted notification permission, it
      // should update its UI reflecting this.
      resetUI();
      // [END_EXCLUDE]
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
      //console.log('Unable to get permission to notify.', err);
    });
    // [END request_permission]
  }

  function deleteToken() {
    // Delete Instance ID token.
    // [START delete_token]
    messaging.getToken()
    .then(function(currentToken) {
      messaging.deleteToken(currentToken)
      .then(function() {
        //console.log('Token deleted.');
        setTokenSentToServer(false);
        // [START_EXCLUDE]
        // Once token is deleted update UI.
        resetUI();
        // [END_EXCLUDE]
      })
      .catch(function(err) {
        //console.log('Unable to delete token. ', err);
      });
      // [END delete_token]
    })
    .catch(function(err) {
      //console.log('Error retrieving Instance ID token. ', err);
      showToken('Error retrieving Instance ID token. ', err);
    });

  }

  // Add a message to the messages element.
  function appendMessage(payload) {
    const messagesElement = document.querySelector('#messages');
    const dataHeaderELement = document.createElement('h5');
    const dataElement = document.createElement('pre');
    dataElement.style = 'overflow-x:hidden;'
    dataHeaderELement.textContent = 'Received message:';
    dataElement.textContent = JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
    messagesElement.appendChild(dataHeaderELement);
    messagesElement.appendChild(dataElement);
  }

  // Clear the messages element of all children.
  function clearMessages() {
    const messagesElement = document.querySelector('#messages');
    while (messagesElement.hasChildNodes()) {
      messagesElement.removeChild(messagesElement.lastChild);
    }
  }

  function updateUIForPushEnabled(currentToken) {
    showHideDiv(tokenDivId, true);
    showHideDiv(permissionDivId, false);
    showToken(currentToken);
  }

  function updateUIForPushPermissionRequired() {
    showHideDiv(tokenDivId, false);
    showHideDiv(permissionDivId, true);
  }
  
  function notificationpopupclose(){
	$(".req_notif_perm_main_block").css({"display":"none"});
	$.ajax({
			url:"/"+jsLang+"/home/HideNotificationPopup",
			type:'post',
			data:{"status":"hide"},
			success: function (data) {
				//console.log('token inserted to db');

			},
			error: function () {
				//	alert('unable to get Restaurant') ;
			}
		}) ;

		return false;
	console.log("close");
  }
  
  function secondNotificationPopupShow(){
  
	$("#notification-second-popup").css({"display":"block"});
	$("#notification-second-popup").animate({right: '40'},1200);
	
	setTimeout(function(){
		$("#notification-second-popup").animate({right: '-700'},1200, function(){
			$("#notification-second-popup").css({"display":"none"});
		});  
		
	}, 60000);

  }

  function secondnotificationpopupclose(){
	$("#notification-second-popup").animate({right: '-700'},1200, function(){
			$("#notification-second-popup").css({"display":"none"});
		});  
  }
  
  resetUI();
  
  detectPrivateMode(
  
        function(is_private) {
		
            //document.getElementById('result').innerHTML = typeof is_private === 'undefined' ? 'cannot detect' : is_private ? 'private' : 'not private';
			if(typeof is_private === 'undefined'){
				$(".req_notif_perm_main_block").css({"display":"none"});
			}
			else if(is_private){
				$(".req_notif_perm_main_block").css({"display":"none"});
			}
			else{
				if(readCookie('hidenotificationpopup')==null){
					setTimeout(function(){
						$(".req_notif_perm_main_block").css({"display":"block"});
					}, 1500)
					
				}
			}
			
			
        }
		
		
    );
  
  //requestPermission();
</script>
